'''Meera Lisso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[Almas Academy]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Lisso was 19 when she began her [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] and she trained under [[Zelice Sturm]].

{{RPG|''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]''}}
Lisso survived the [[destruction of the Almas Academy]], but witnessed Sturm's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] during it. This drove her close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and afterwards, she accompanied the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on a mission to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to find Ezzar.
